class.name: UZUScatter
class.brief_description: Spreads small props over a surface as one MultiMesh.
class.description: [UZUScatter] places many small props (stones, tufts, flowers, debris) over the triangles of a surface mesh. Points are spread evenly by area. A fixed seed always gives the same layout, so a scene can be rebuilt exactly. Props can be filtered by slope, exclusion zones and a minimum spacing. [method scatter] draws them as one [MultiMeshInstance3D], so thousands of props cost about one draw call. [codeblock] var stats = UZUScatter.scatter(self, $Ground, preload("res://rock.tres"), { "density": 0.5, "seed": 3, "scale_min": 0.2, "scale_max": 0.4, "min_distance": 0.6, "exclude": [{"center": Vector3.ZERO, "radius": 3.0}], }, "Stones") print(stats.count, stats.bounds) [/codeblock] [b]Note:[/b] This class is specific to U.ZU Engine.

method.name: compute_transforms
method.description: Returns the transforms of the props on [param surface], whose triangles are first moved by [param surface_transform]. See [method get_defaults] for the [param options]. An unknown option is an error, and the result is empty.

method.name: get_defaults
method.description: Returns the options with their defaults: - [code]density[/code]: props per square meter. - [code]seed[/code]: the layout; the same seed gives the same props. - [code]scale_min[/code] and [code]scale_max[/code]: a random uniform scale between them. - [code]random_yaw[/code]: turn each prop at random around its up axis. - [code]align[/code] (0..1): how much props lean with the surface (0 = upright). - [code]max_slope[/code] (degrees): steeper ground gets no props. - [code]min_distance[/code] (meters): the least distance between two props. - [code]sink[/code] (meters): pushes props into the ground. - [code]max_count[/code]: an upper limit. - [code]exclude[/code]: an [Array] of zones without props: [code]{"center": Vector3, "radius": float}[/code] (a circle on the ground plane) or [code]{"aabb": AABB}[/code].

method.name: scatter
method.description: Scatters [param mesh] over [param surface] and adds the props as a [MultiMeshInstance3D] named [param name] under [param root]. The new node is owned by [param root], so it is saved with the scene. The surface's transform is taken relative to [param root]. Returns [code]ok[/code], [code]node[/code], [code]count[/code], [code]target[/code] (area × density), [code]area[/code], [code]bounds[/code] (an [AABB] around the props' positions), and how many points were rejected for slope, exclusion and spacing ([code]rejected_slope[/code], [code]rejected_excluded[/code], [code]rejected_spacing[/code]). On failure it returns [code]ok[/code] false and [code]error[/code].
